name: Science Laboratory
shortDescription: Hands-on experiments in physics, chemistry and biology.
detailedDescription: The science laboratory is where curiosity turns into experiments. Students work at shared benches with glassware, microscopes and models, always following safety rules guided by their teachers. Projects made here are often shown at science exhibitions.
